comparison_boundary: Describe/ByPath collection ordering and page boundaries are not pinned. Full aggregate members/cardinality remain compared; GetParameters name ordering and history order are retained. All native page requests/responses remain in fixtures.

findings.finding: StringList preserves spaces and empty elements verbatim.
Omitted overwrite metadata retains Description and AllowedPattern; retained pattern still validates new values.
Labels move between immutable versions; valid labels can succeed alongside InvalidLabels.
ByPath Label can select a historical version without Selector in output; Label accepts only one filter value.
Bare and slash-prefixed top-level names resolve to the same ARN; reads echo request spelling, batch preserves both aliases, Describe preserves stored spelling.
Batch invalid names are sorted and deduplicated; exact valid duplicates deduplicate while ARN/name aliases remain distinct. Equal-name tie order is not an input-order contract.
Empty selector is ValidationException; numeric leading zero resolves version 1 and preserves Selector :01; overlong label is ValidationException.
Standard policies rejected; NoChange After requires positive integer; duplicate identical Expiration and [{}] inputs accepted; [] clearing confirmed.
String to StringList and SecureString to String updates succeed; omitted SecureString KeyId retains alias/aws/ssm.
String to SecureString also succeeds with default KMS alias; history retains each version type and key metadata.

All 99 selected semantic requests observed. PutParameter redacts value for every parameter type; reads have responseElements:null. Observed API failures also omit errorCode/errorMessage in CloudTrail. Resources carry ARN and accountId without type; DescribeParameters omits resources.
Change events use name/operation/type and optional description. Label events carry singular label plus string fromVersion/toVersion; first association fromVersion is empty string.
Empty first-create raw JSON1.1 PutParameter returns HTTP400 ValidationException minimum length 1; subsequent GetParameter confirms no resource exists.
AWS-published Policy Action schema requires action-status, parameter-name, parameter-type, policy-content (JSON string), policy-type; action-reason is optional. Not notification-delivery proof.

Stateless Secrets Manager references require decryption and both service authorities; canonical UUID selectors choose versions, other selectors choose stages. SourceResult differs from the public Secrets Manager response and binary references omit Value.

PutSecretValue does not expose VersionStage context; absent-secret authorization honors broad unknown-six-character suffix grants but denies exact or restricted suffix grants. Shared scalar metadata remains unchanged.
